items.example: I forgot my umbrella and got wet.
items.mnemonic: Турист с ветчиной намок — get wet.

items.example: Without a jacket you'll get cold in the mountains.
items.mnemonic: Ковбой с кольтом замёрз — get cold.

items.example: I get hot in summer and I need to get warm in winter.
items.mnemonic: Атлет с хот-догом греется — get hot, get warm.

items.example: I stayed up too late and got really tired.
items.mnemonic: Клерк считает тариф и устал — get tired.

items.example: I didn't eat breakfast so I'm getting hungry.
items.mnemonic: Хан требует еды — get hungry, проголодаться.

items.example: I was out in Istanbul. I didn't have a satnav or a map so I got lost.
I stayed out in the sun and got sunburnt.
She put her hand on a bee and got stung.
items.mnemonic: Пчела танцует танго и кусает — get stung.

items.example: Can I sit by the fire? I need to get warm.
items.mnemonic: Артист с фаером сел у камина — sit by the fire.

items.example: A mobile often won't work because there's no signal.
items.mnemonic: Турист машет сигой — there's no signal, нет сигнала.

items.phrase: what do you do in this situation?
items.translation: что ты делаешь в такой ситуации?
items.example: What do you do if you're in a car?
items.mnemonic: Повар с ситом спрашивает — what do you do in this situation.

items.example: Are you ready for nature's little surprises?
items.mnemonic: Скаут с редиской готов — Are you ready, ты готов.

items.example: Take a credit card, a phone and some water.
items.mnemonic: Критик машет кредиткой — take a credit card, взять карту.
